root_cause.text: In ceph_process_folio_batch(), `ceph_wbc->num_ops` is incremented when a folio starts a new contiguous extent, but if `move_dirty_folio_in_page_array()` subsequently fails (e.g., due to a crypto bounce buffer allocation failure), the folio is not added, leaving `num_ops` one count too high and triggering a BUG_ON in `ceph_submit_write()`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state: "if this failed folio is not contiguous with the last folio that did make it into the batch, then ceph_process_folio_batch() has already incremented `ceph_wbc->num_ops`; because it doesn't follow through and add the discontiguous folio to the array, ceph_submit_write() will panic." The patch adds a decrement of `ceph_wbc->num_ops` when the failure occurs and `ceph_wbc->len == 0` (i.e., the new extent was empty).

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: In ceph_process_folio_batch(), `ceph_wbc->num_ops` is incremented when a folio starts a new contiguous extent, but if `move_dirty_folio_in_page_array()` subsequently fails (e.g., due to a crypto bounce buffer allocation failure), the folio is not added, leaving `num_ops` one count too high and triggering a BUG_ON in `ceph_submit_write()`.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE description and commit message state: "if this failed folio is not contiguous with the last folio that did make it into the batch, then ceph_process_folio_batch() has already incremented `ceph_wbc->num_ops`; because it doesn't follow through and add the discontiguous folio to the array, ceph_submit_write() will panic." The patch adds a decrement of `ceph_wbc->num_ops` when the failure occurs and `ceph_wbc->len == 0` (i.e., the new extent was empty).

candidates.rationale: This function call is where failure can occur; if it fails, num_ops remains incremented, causing BUG_ON later.
Completion of the function call; failure here without num_ops rollback leads to count mismatch.
Checks for failure but does not include a decrement of num_ops, leaving it inconsistent.
Redirties the folio but does not adjust num_ops, missing the needed rollback.
Unlocks the folio on failure without correcting the num_ops count.
Exits the loop on failure, leaving num_ops permanently incremented without the expected folio.

vuln_statements.explanation: This function call attempts to add the folio to the page array; if it fails (e.g., crypto bounce buffer allocation failure), the folio is not actually added, but num_ops has already been incremented (elsewhere in the loop) for this folio, causing a count mismatch.
Completion of the function call; failure after this point (same call) leads to missing decrement of num_ops, leaving it overcounted.
This branch handles the failure of move_dirty_folio_in_page_array, but does not decrement ceph_wbc->num_ops, which was incremented earlier for this folio, so the count remains too high.
Redirties the folio on failure but does not adjust num_ops, missing the required rollback to keep num_ops consistent with the number of folios actually added.
Unlocks the folio on failure without correcting the num_ops count, so the overcount persists.
Exits the loop on failure, leaving num_ops permanently incremented without the corresponding folio being committed, which later triggers a BUG_ON in ceph_submit_write().
